designLab.title: Design lab
designLab.devOnly: Development only. Nothing here reaches the production build, and nothing you do here is saved. All data is sample data.

round1.title: Round 1: overall direction
round1.body: Four directions, each applied to the project list with the same sample data. Try each at full width and at phone width, in light and dark, and click through creating, renaming, deleting and restoring a project. Pick one, combine parts of several, or ask for another round.

workbench.name: A. Workbench
workbench.summary: A quiet, modern tool. Sidebar navigation, a dense table, neutral greys with one blue accent. Feels like GitHub or Linear.

dossier.name: B. Dossier
dossier.summary: 1930s staff paperwork. Olive and brass on warm paper, serif headings, typewriter details, projects as file folders with stamps.

warroom.name: C. War room
warroom.summary: A command console. Dark navy first, amber and teal signals, condensed capitals, status readouts and a grid of project tiles. Closest to the game's own feel.

studio.name: D. Studio
studio.summary: Friendly and roomy. Rounded cards, soft colors, big type and generous space, each project with a flag-style banner. Easiest for newcomers.
